<mxGeometry x="1505" y="434.5" width="110" height="39.5" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="I-TNLLBIKghRffwVaEJ6-72" value="<h1 style="margin-top: 0px;">Scene Loading</h1><p></p><ol><li>When player is in a <b>region</b> scene, it's ajoining transition scenes must also be loaded</li><li>when a player is in a <b>transition</b> scene, it's ajoining region scenes must be loaded</li><li>all other scenes should be unloaded</li></ol><p></p>" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;rounded=0;labelBackgroundColor=none;fillColor=#f5f5f5;fontColor=#333333;strokeColor=#666666;" 0px;">Transition scenes</h1><p></p><ul><li>small scenes which connect regions</li><li>region scenes should not be visible from transition scenes, OR the transition scene should contain<br>copies of the visible assets OR other placeholders&nbsp;</li><li>all other scenes should be unloaded</li><li>LOS needs to be blocked between all exits</li></ul><p></p>"
